text:
emily: Hey team — quick design review request. I'm iterating on the playground's run history entries when a tool call returns structured output (JSON schema). Two things: the inline annotation badges and the collapsed summary copy. Wanted feedback on legibility + screen reader behavior. TL;DR: compact vs readable tradeoff.

sam: Love it. Can you paste a mock of the collapsed state and expanded state? makes it easier to comment on copy.

emily: Sure — collapsed: `Order #12345 — 3 items (schema) · tool: inventory_service` with a small gray pill that says `structured` and a chevron. Expanded shows a header `Inventory response` then a two-column key/value view and a raw JSON tab.

nina: My first thought: the pill `structured` is vague. Maybe `schema output` or `structured result (JSON)` — we often call it schema elsewhere. Also color contrast on the gray pill is borderline (AA fail).

jon: +1 on using `schema`. Also suggest an icon (braces {}) + visually distinct background so it reads at a glance. For collapsed copy: `Inventory response — schema · 3 items` reads better (subject first).

emily: Good call. What about screen readers? Right now the pill is just a span with text. We could expose `aria-label="Structured output, JSON schema"` and make the collapsed item announce `Inventory response, schema output, 3 items, tool inventory_service`

andy: For the expanded view: prefer heading level H4 for `Inventory response` so it appears in SR navigation. And the two-column view needs explicit `role="table"` and `aria-label` for screen readers since it's visually tabular.

sam: UX nit: when the run was from a function call, should we show the function name and the function signature inline? e.g., `getInventory(product_id: string) -> schema` so it's clear which def produced it.

emily: I like inline signature. It also helps disambiguate when multiple tool calls in one run. Maybe make the signature secondary text in a lighter color.

nina: Copy suggestion for collapsed: `Inventory response (schema) — from inventory_service.getInventory()` — explicit and scannable.

emily: Nice. Any thoughts on the JSON/raw tab label? Currently `JSON` and `Preview`. Some folks confuse `Preview` with a visual HTML preview. Might be clearer as `Formatted` vs `Raw JSON` or `Structured` vs `Raw`

jon: `Formatted` / `Raw JSON` sounds fine. Also, show a small token count for the rendered preview to help devs estimate cost.

andy: Accessibility: ensure keyboard focus enters the expanded panel and that `Esc` closes it. Also provide a `Copy JSON` button with `aria-live` toast so SR knows copy succeeded.

emily: Great checklist — I'll add to the spec. One more: run history density — we have an option to show compact rows. If we show `schema` badges in compact mode, they need tighter spacing and possibly only the icon (no text) with an accessible name.

sam: Icon-only works if the hover tooltip and SR label are present. Tooltip text: `Structured output (JSON schema)`

nina: Small copy tweak: use sentence case for pills — `Schema` not `schema` — matches other pills in console.

emily: Noted. Design-bot, can you generate updated mock with these changes?

design-bot: @emily generated 3 mocks: `compact-icon-only`, `collapsed-with-signature`, `expanded-table-a11y`. Link: https://figma.redwood.team/s/PLAYGROUND-STRUCTURED-2460001234

emily: Perfect. I'll attach the figma and propose the changes in the PR: pill text `Schema`, collapsed copy `Inventory response (Schema) — inventory_service.getInventory()`, tab labels `Formatted` / `Raw JSON`, ARIA additions, and compact-mode icon-only pill with tooltip. Any objections?

jon: No objections. Please add a screenshot of contrast numbers for the pill.

andy: Also add test plan lines: keyboard nav, NVDA/VoiceOver quick pass, tooltip SR announcements.

emily: Will do. Thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
